falseSynonyms.zh: 職員無禮 ≠ 所有 poor service rude staff 描述人員態度，不涵蓋系統故障、等候時間或支援不足。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Rudeness is only one dimension of service quality.

falseSynonyms.zh: 顧客投訴 ≠ poor service complaint 是顧客作出的反應／文件，不是服務本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A complaint reports a problem; it is not the service.

falseSynonyms.zh: 服務失誤 ≠ poor service service failure 通常指一次具體失敗事件；poor service 可指整體或持續質素差。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A service failure is often a specific incident.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不友善 ≠ poor service unfriendly 只描述態度，未必代表整體服務不合格。
便宜的服務 ≠ poor service cheap 可指價格低；價格低不代表質素差。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cheap refers to price unless context clearly means low quality.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在服務『不足』sense 接近 inadequate 著重不足以滿足需要，不涵蓋所有服務差的情況。
詞性陷阱 service 是名詞；serve 是動詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Service names the provision; serve is the action.
